# mifdlal.com

> Portfolio and services page of Mifdlal Tsaqib Alfarras: freelance web developer and AI automation specialist, working remotely from Bandung, Indonesia. The site's primary language is English, with an Indonesian version on the same pages.

## Pages

- [Home and portfolio](https://mifdlal.com/): short profile, five projects you can open, three services, work experience, education, certifications, and contact.
- [Project index](https://mifdlal.com/proyek/): five projects with a screenshot each, plus title, role, description, and the stack used.
- [Service index](https://mifdlal.com/layanan/): the three services, each with a one-line description.

## Services

- Websites and web apps: landing pages, company profiles, e-commerce, up to POS systems. Handled from design through launch.
- Chatbots: automatic replies and answers drawn from your business data, not fixed templates.
- AI automation and workflow: AI handles incoming messages, summarises customer context, and sends automatic replies.

## Projects

- [PT Loka Logistics Solution](https://lokalogistics.co.id/), logistics company profile site, WordPress.
- [UT Bandung Exam Location Simulator](https://simulasi-pemilihan-lokasi-ujian-ut.vercel.app/), six-step wizard app, Vite.
- [Mahoni-House](https://mahoni-house.vercel.app), bilingual villa landing page, Next.js.
- [Conduit](https://conduit-iota-rust.vercel.app), video source extractor with an Express API and React interface, TypeScript + Playwright.
- [Orbit CLI](https://mifdlaldev.github.io/orbit-cli/), project generator for seven frameworks, TypeScript.

## Technical notes

- Static Astro site, served by Cloudflare Workers at mifdlal.com.
- The home page carries the summary; project and service detail pages are not published yet. Main content stays readable without JavaScript.
